verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents automatic vectorization at import using integrated models, so objects can be imported without manually specifying embeddings (weaviate-gh-1, weaviate-docs-12). It integrates with a range of self-hosted and API-based model providers (weaviate-docs-20), offers its own Weaviate Embeddings service (weaviate-docs-15), and can run a local embedding model via Docker (weaviate-gh-2). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that queries are vectorized at query time (only implied by semantic and hybrid search), independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in vectorizers, and detail on which providers are supported.
